Watching how political support actually works.
beats.detail: Inside the machinery of presidential public defense.
beats.narration: Here is how a president publicly backs their own people when scandals hit the headlines.

beats.caption: Trump defends Hegseth against impeachment calls.
beats.detail: Republican senator Thomas Massie leads the charge.
beats.narration: Donald Trump is standing by defense secretary Pete Hegseth amid calls for his impeachment.

beats.caption: The president cites two wars as proof.
beats.detail: Trump is pushing back against the resolution.
beats.narration: Trump says Hegseth should stay because he won two wars. He is dismissing the current controversy.

beats.caption: Trump addresses the Nvidia CEO directly.
beats.detail: The conversation follows serious allegations about Huang.
beats.narration: Trump is also talking about Nvidia boss Jensen Huang. He says he spoke to him directly.

beats.caption: Trump calls spy claims truly amazing.
beats.detail: The president is weighing in on tech rumors.
beats.narration: Reports claim Huang had an affair with a Chinese spy. Trump says he is amazed by this.

data.left_text: Hegseth faces removal by Republican senator Massie
data.right_text: Huang faces allegations involving a Chinese spy

beats.caption: How presidential influence shifts public opinion.
beats.detail: Trump is actively managing these two controversies.
beats.narration: This shows how the president uses his voice to shape the narrative around his key allies.
